use py:urllib.parse as urls
foreign urls.unquote(Text) -> Text
use net:System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex as Rx
use js:"node:path/posix" as path
use js:semver as sv

unit kb
unit mb = 1024 kb

record Artifact {
    raw_path: Text
    channel: Text
    size_kb: Int
}

record Request {
    min_range: Text
    budget_mb: Float
    artifacts: List[Artifact]
}

fn fits_budget(used: Float[kb], budget: Float[mb]) -> Bool pure =
    used <= (budget to kb)

fn valid_channel(ch: Text) -> Bool pure =
    ch == "stable" or ch == "beta" or ch == "lts"

fn size_tier(size_kb: Int) -> Text pure = cases size_kb {
    < 100 => "tiny"
    <= 1000 => "standard"
    <= 5000 => "large"
    else => "oversize"
}

fn is_base_eligible(valid_path: Bool, channel: Text, semver_ok: Bool, tier: Text) -> Bool pure =
    valid_path and valid_channel(channel) and semver_ok and tier != "oversize"

fn is_lts_security_exempt(valid_path: Bool, pkg: Text, channel: Text, clean_ver: Text, tier: Text) -> Bool pure =
    valid_path and channel == "lts" and str_contains(pkg, "security") and clean_ver != "" and str_contains(clean_ver, "-") == false and tier != "oversize"

fn inspect_artifact(a: Artifact, min_range: Text) =
    let decoded = urls.unquote(a.raw_path) in
    let norm = path.normalize(decoded) in
    let ver = path.basename(norm) in
    let pkg = path.dirname(norm) in
    let valid_path = Rx.IsMatch(norm, "^[a-z0-9-]+/[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+(-[a-z0-9.]+)?$") in
    let clean_ver = sv.valid(ver) ?? "" in
    let semver_ok = if clean_ver != "" then sv.satisfies(clean_ver, min_range) else false in
    let tier = size_tier(a.size_kb) in
    let base_eligible = is_base_eligible(valid_path, a.channel, semver_ok, tier) in
    let lts_exempt = is_lts_security_exempt(valid_path, pkg, a.channel, clean_ver, tier) in
    let exempt = lts_exempt and base_eligible == false in
    let eligible = base_eligible or lts_exempt in
    record {
        norm,
        pkg,
        ver,
        channel: a.channel,
        size_kb: a.size_kb,
        tier,
        exempt,
        eligible
    }

let req: Request = from_json(stdin_text())
let evaluated = [inspect_artifact(a, req.min_range) for a in req.artifacts]

let s = summarize x in evaluated {
    total: count
    eligible: count where x.eligible
    oversize: count where x.tier == "oversize"
    exempt: count where x.exempt
    total_kb: sum x.size_kb
    max_kb: max x.size_kb default 0
    eligible_kb: sum x.size_kb where x.eligible
}

let consecutive_rejects = count adjacent prev, curr in evaluated where prev.eligible == false and curr.eligible == false
let freeze = consecutive_rejects >= 2
let within_budget = fits_budget(to_float(s.eligible_kb) as kb, req.budget_mb as mb)
let eligible_versions = [x.ver for x in evaluated where x.eligible]
let recommended = sv.maxSatisfying(eligible_versions, ">=0.0.0")

let out = record {
    total: s.total,
    eligible: s.eligible,
    oversize: s.oversize,
    exempt: s.exempt,
    total_kb: s.total_kb,
    max_kb: s.max_kb,
    eligible_kb: s.eligible_kb,
    within_budget,
    consecutive_rejects,
    freeze,
    recommended
}

print json_encode(out)
